notes: Dedicated coalescing microbenchmark: num_threads fixed at 2^20 (--n), stride swept. out[i*stride]=in[i*stride] for i in [0, num_threads); useful bytes moved is constant across the sweep (2 * num_threads * 4 bytes), isolating access-pattern as the sole variable behind effective_bandwidth_gb_s. Max buffer footprint at stride=128 is ~512 MiB per array.
